references.text: The original instruction from God to Moses to make bells and pomegranates on the robe. Exodus 39:26 describes the fulfillment of this command.
Explains the purpose of the bells—that their sound may be heard when Aaron enters the sanctuary to serve before the Lord's presence.
The immediate context describing how the pomegranates and bells of pure gold were made for the hem of the robe.
The introduction to the chapter establishing that everything was done just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
A summary stating that the Israelites did all the work exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
The original instruction (28:34) compared with the actual execution (39:26), showing complete obedience to God's detailed command.
The direct command (28:33) explaining why the robe in 39:26 is designed exactly as it is.
